public_boundary: Only scrubbed patterns, counts, and synthetic examples are published. Raw packets, source titles, UUIDs, raw source excerpts, people, clients, private paths, and exact routing rules are withheld.

themes.summary: Repeated work should become the smallest useful artifact: prompt, context pack, skill, workflow, hook, specialist agent, or full operating kit.
themes.improvement: Create a formal artifact registry with owner, version, evals, retirement criteria, provenance, safety notes, and cost notes.

themes.summary: Long-running agents need explicit state: discovered, classified, moved, skipped, ambiguous, verified, remaining, and blocked.
themes.improvement: Require live progress ledgers, checkpoints, rollback plans, and regenerated handoffs for connector or overnight jobs.

themes.summary: If a repo or page may become public, the data model must be synthetic from the start. Git history is part of the privacy surface.
themes.improvement: Add a public/private/mixed preflight question to every build request and use private overlays for real data.

themes.summary: Complex answers improve when source inventory, filesystem review, outside research, and final synthesis are separate lanes.
themes.improvement: Use evidence lanes with schema, provenance, fallback rules, and no premature recommendations.

themes.theme: Settled decisions must bind future work
themes.summary: The agent should not reintroduce deprecated architecture after the user has corrected it.
themes.improvement: Maintain a settled-decisions file and require every future agent to read it before generating architecture or copy.

themes.summary: Different jobs need different harnesses: read-only monitoring, scoped batch writing, broad-write automation, drafting, and parallel research are not the same agent problem.
themes.improvement: Define agent tiers, approval modes, sandbox rules, memory boundaries, and cost tracking.

themes.summary: Avoiding generic AI design requires a pre-build ritual: diagnose convergence, choose a direction, bind the design spec, and audit the result.
themes.improvement: Add an anti-template design check to public-facing builds.

themes.theme: Scope discipline is a quality signal
themes.summary: A strong agent preserves ambition while shipping the smallest useful version first.
themes.improvement: Label requirements as ship-now, later, or not-yet before producing implementation plans.

themes.summary: Useful agents turn rough notes into concise client-safe recaps, decision requests, and next actions without inflating the tone.
themes.improvement: Create reusable briefs for audience, tone, must-include facts, must-avoid phrases, and privacy constraints.

themes.summary: Chat/session history alone is not enough for client-facing billing; calendars, emails, drafts, deliverables, and unrelated noise must be reconciled.
themes.improvement: Standardize fields for work date, source-event date, evidence, delivery status, billability, estimate, confidence, and follow-up.
